The invoice and shipment dates are both October 2, 2026. The November 1, 2026 due date is 30 days after the invoice date, consistent with Net 30 terms. Invoice Fields!C6:C10 agrees with the PDF, and both supplied payment-term checks pass.

The comparable field-sheet values agree with the main invoice, including invoice identification at Invoice Fields!C5, currency at C11, seller details at C16:C20, buyer details at C24:C28, goods at C34:C39 and C42:C43, and trade terms and delivery location at C56:C57.
